title: Hangover-Cure Kenyan Herbal Tender Tea Stew
description: A soothing Kenyan stew featuring herbal tea, clotted cream, and a hint of tadka to cure hangover symptoms while being vegan-friendly

ingredients.name: Tender shoots of Bitter Leaf ( Vernonia amygdalina )
Tadka spice blend
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: In a large kettle, combine Bitter Leaf shoots, green tea leaves, ginger root, and vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Strain the tea into a separate pot, discarding the solids.
In a large saucepan, heat the tadka spice blend over medium heat for 1-2 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, clotted cream, and chopped fresh mint leaves. Stir until well combined.
Gradually add the strained herbal tea to the saucepan, whisking continuously.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Simmer the stew over low heat for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with additional fresh mint leaves if desired.
